mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE tree (id, parent_id, name, enabled, effective, version, depth) AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, name, enabled, enabled, version, 0 FROM iam_org_unit WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT u.id, u.parent_id, u.name, u.enabled, t.effective AND u.enabled, u.version, t.depth + 1 FROM iam_org_unit u JOIN tree t ON u.parent_id = t.id WHERE t.depth < 1000) SELECT id, parent_id, name, enabled, effective, version FROM tree ORDER BY depth, id
